title: A contract in ServiceNow is not in Solusi
cardHint: Contracts in ServiceNow that the Solusi contract file does not hold. SACM deletes them in ServiceNow; the app deletes nothing.
cardText: Contracts that ServiceNow holds and the Solusi contract file does not (procedure 2.8). What is not in Solusi does not exist, or should not exist, in ServiceNow: every line is to delete. SACM deletes them in ServiceNow; the app deletes nothing. A note "Still linked" on a line only says what links the contract to the CMDB. If Procurement asks to keep a contract, open it and choose Not followed up, with the reason.
subject: contract
